def _git_tracked_files() -> set[Path]:
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "ls-files"],
        cwd=ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return {ROOT / line.strip() for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()}
